name: Ace Sponge: The Great SquarePants Chronicles
summary:
A dark secret lives under the sea. Bikini Bottom is a land where serious crimes are rare, yet something unexpected happened - a murder was committed in the Krusty Krab. In the chaos, Mr. Krabs was arrested, but with his last grasp for resistance, he asks SpongeBob to defend him in court.

Now, SpongeBob will have to face the legal system as a makeshift attorney to defend his boss. Only time can tell whether SpongeBobs' trust is misplaced or not, if Mr. Krabs is truly innocent or guilty.

Join the 5+ hour adventure in an Ace Attorney style trial to find the truth, the truth of what truly happened to Sheldon "Shell" Jhonson!
